title: GET /api/v1/feed/replies?after=SEQ&limit=N success
description: The account's replies that changed after `after` (all of them without it), increasing seq: machines find the pending replies they deliver, and every machine the threads to show. Pending replies older than an hour are expired first. `more` says further changes wait; `latest_seq` is the account's greatest reply seq, 0 without replies.
